title: Keynote: The Lithium Price Cycle
gist: Member-only video page for Traxys lithium advisor Wei Xiong's 24-minute keynote on the lithium price cycle at Benchmark Week 2026. The page has no description, transcript or price views of its own, only blurbs for other sessions, so this card is very thin.

insights.claim: Wei Xiong, Lithium Advisor at trader Traxys, gave a 24-minute keynote on the lithium price cycle at Benchmark Week 2026 on Nov 11, 2026. The page is member-only and states no price views, forecasts or cycle timing.
insights.speaker: Wei Xiong, Lithium Advisor, Traxys
insights.so_what: A trading-house view on where lithium sits in its price cycle would matter for lithium equities, but none is disclosed here.

insights.claim: A Benchmark Week 2026 panel on grid-scale batteries framed energy storage (ESS) as the next demand frontier, covering ESS market growth, which battery chemistries are winning, and the grid infrastructure investment required.
insights.speaker: Wei Xiong, Lithium Advisor, Traxys
insights.so_what: Benchmark is positioning stationary storage as the next leg of battery raw material demand, relevant to lithium and LFP supply chains.
insights.quote: How the ESS market is growing, which chemistries are winning, and the infrastructure investment the future grid will need.

insights.claim: Benchmark's cathode market update at Benchmark Week 2026 covered cathode and precursor capacity growth across Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, and regional pricing arbitrage between them.
insights.speaker: Wei Xiong, Lithium Advisor, Traxys
insights.so_what: Cathode capacity is spreading beyond China to Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, and regional price gaps create arbitrage that affects producer margins.
insights.quote: Cathode and precursor capacity growth across Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, regional pricing arbitrage, and which producers are leading global expansion.
